headline: Enhancing ClearInstall with Trend Signals
summary: By integrating public trend signals, ClearInstall can better identify and mitigate risks associated with npm/PyPI packages. This will help users ensure their local-first applications are secure before installation.
actions: Integrate dependency analysis from cleanyourtv to detect potential security vulnerabilities in binding.gyp files.
Use DeepInfer's machine learning models to predict and warn about risky package dependencies based on historical data.
Implement a native game compatibility checker inspired by MacNativeGames, ensuring that all installed packages are compatible with the user’s local environment.
